title: Someone Finally Fixed Installing Apps on a Mac
summary: Then, to keep things tidy, you need to unmount the virtual disk and delete the DMG file. By default, EasyDMG will automatically delete the DMG file for you, then open a Finder window revealing your new application in the Applications folder.
